tiles: Mountains curl into waves under radiant skies
Technicolor cloud fields with disciplined motion
challenge: Merging the rigid geometric vocabulary of constructivism with the fluid, dreamlike quality of surrealist landscapes. The creative brief called for compositions where mountains dissolve into ocean waves and technicolor cloud formations fill radiant skies, all held together by disciplined structural axes.
approach: Used Adobe Firefly to generate sweeping landscape compositions anchored by constructivist grid lines and gradient rhythms. Lightroom handled color grading to achieve cinematic warmth, while in-painting refined cloud-wave transitions, edge control, and value pacing for cohesive flow across each panel.
result: Delivered a vivid six-piece series of surreal landscape panels that read instantly at thumbnail scale and sustain layered depth at full resolution. The collection is ready for large-format art prints, gallery exhibition, and digital portfolio presentation.
